name: Endeavour (STS-77)
about: Endeavour (STS-77) (1996-032A), a crewed vehicle (OV-105), launched 1996 May 19. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1996 May 21), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW33); its coordinates are written from memory
